name: seekframe
description: Make motion-graphics explainer videos from code with the seekframe app: a TOML project of shared claims, hooks and closes composed into one cut per audience, a deterministic seek(t) scene page rendered in headless Chromium with motion blur, a synthesized score, careful per-line ElevenLabs voice-over that re-times the scenes, subtitles, 16:9 and 9:16 Shorts, and a YouTube upload sheet; plus import of old videos.mjs projects.
